m1.text: My son Niko hung a hook by the window. My mom Suri measured the space underneath it.

m2.text: My dentist made a stained-glass fish for the window. Its tail is bright orange.

m3.text: My friend Tess came to see the fish. My nephew Omar drew a matching one on paper.

m4.text: Dina made the stained-glass fish with the orange tail that arrived in September. I found the little card that came with it.

m5.text: My dentist's son Pax delivered a replacement hook. My friend's mom Hana brought a drill.

m6.text: Bo isn't my dentist; Bo repaired the kitchen cabinet. My mom's lasagna was ready by the time the hinges were fitted.

m7.text: Tess sent a message about Emre: 'My son wants to learn glasswork. Could you send a photograph of the fish?'

m1.text: My grandpa Emil died in 2017. My wife Noor found his watch in the sewing drawer.

m2.text: My doctor Anya Bell sees me at the morning clinic; my doctor Asa Brook sees me at the evening clinic. Both are treating me this year.

m3.text: The appointment card says my doctor will call at noon. It is signed 'A. B.'

m4.text: In 2018, my late grandpa's watch stopped during the train ride. I wrapped it in a handkerchief.

m5.text: My doctors sent their appointment lists in one envelope. Booking systems vary from doctor to doctor.

m6.text: Noor said, 'my grandpa Tomas wore a watch just like that.' We put a photograph of it beside the sewing drawer.

m1.text: My only sister brought a picnic blanket. My father-in-law Karim packed a thermos.

m2.text: My coach wrote a walking plan in a dark green notebook. The first route ends beside the picnic field.

m3.text: I have two neighbours on this landing. My neighbour Pia keeps a bicycle by the lift. Mi vecino Rem keeps a trolley by the stairs.

m4.text: I put a label reading 'from my neighbor' on the borrowed picnic basket in the hall.

m5.text: Our neighbours brought chairs to the picnic field. We carried them home before the rain.

m6.text: My sister's coach Edda sent a map of a longer route. I tucked it into the picnic basket.

m1.text: My boss lent me a projector today for the community film night. I signed the loan slip in blue ink.

m2.text: Mi mamá Inés made popcorn for the film night. My ex Luca returned the extension cable before everyone arrived.

m3.text: Ari returned the projector to Nadia, the user's boss, with the loan slip folded inside the case.

m4.text: My new boss Owen now signs the travel forms; my former boss Nadia moved to another team today.

m5.text: In 2023, my boss approved the train fare for the winter workshop.

m6.text: March 2024 notebook page: My boss approved the late train home. The ticket cost eighteen pounds.

m7.text: The Nadia app archived the receipt. My cat Owen slept on the scanner.
